description: Applies one requested change to an existing component's HTML with AnimatedWebs AI and returns the complete updated HTML document. Use it to iterate on a generate_component result (or any self-contained HTML component); use generate_component to start from scratch. Output has the same shape as generate_component (HTML text block with a model comment; structuredContent html, model, generationsLeftToday). Uses one daily generation from the same shared allowance (Free 5, Pro 100 per UTC day); a call where no model ran is not counted. Not idempotent. If the generator is busy it returns an error; retry after a minute. Example: {"html":"<!doctype html>...","change":"make the cards glass and add a hover tilt","style":"glass"}.

change.description: One change, 4 to 800 characters. Example: 'make the cards glass and add a hover tilt'.

html.description: The current component as a full HTML document, 50 to 60,000 characters; pass the previous output unchanged.

style.description: Visual system to keep: luxury (default), editorial, glass or brutalist. Pass the style the component was generated with.

name: refine_component

generationsLeftToday.description: Generations left for this account today (UTC)

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML document (Tailwind CDN, inline JS)

title: Refine an AnimatedWebs UI component
